adjudicated.en: Touko was here.
adjudicated.assessment: The narration's principal action, state, and local relation are preserved without a material semantic error.

adjudicated.jp: というか、いっつも一等賞じゃないか、こいつ。
adjudicated.en: Or should I say, alllways shooting for first place, ain't she.
adjudicated.assessment: He remarks that she is always the first-place arrival, not that she is continually aspiring or trying to win first place. The English turns an observed result into intention.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'She's always first place, isn't she?'

adjudicated.en: Taichi: "'morning."
adjudicated.assessment: The dialogue's proposition, speech act, and local scene function are preserved without a material semantic error.

adjudicated.en: Touko: "...(pfuiri)"
adjudicated.assessment: The dialogue's proposition, speech act, and local scene function are preserved without a material semantic error.

adjudicated.en: Ostracism?
adjudicated.assessment: The slang asks whether she is ignoring him. 'Ostracism' denotes broader social exclusion and changes the immediate interpersonal act.

adjudicated.en: Is this ostracism I see?
adjudicated.assessment: The repeated slang asks whether she is ignoring him. 'Ostracism' again substitutes a different, broader social process.

adjudicated.en: Taichi: "Wear..."
adjudicated.assessment: The isolated noun is 'underwear' or 'panties,' setting up the following exchange. 'Wear' is not that noun and removes the joke's concrete object.

adjudicated.en: Touko: "Be succint."
adjudicated.assessment: She calls him persistent or tiresome for repeating himself. The English orders him to be concise, changes the speech act, and misspells 'succinct.'

adjudicated.en: Taichi: "Please buy what I wear?"
adjudicated.assessment: He explicitly asks her to buy him underwear. The vague paraphrase 'what I wear' suppresses the concrete object that drives the exchange.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'Won't you buy me some underwear?'

adjudicated.jp: 「どーして私があなたのパンツを買わないといけないのっ！」
adjudicated.en: Touko: "Whyyy would I ever need to buy what you wear?!"
comments: Overreaction, he asks 'please', she uses a stronger 'ought' -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: She explicitly protests having to buy his underwear. The vague paraphrase removes the repeated noun and weakens the comic escalation.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'Why do I have to buy your underwear?'

adjudicated.jp: 机をどついて立ちあがる冬子。
adjudicated.en: Touko stands, slamming fists on the desk.
adjudicated.assessment: The narration's principal action, state, and local relation are preserved without a material semantic error.

adjudicated.en: Taichi: "All hott' from morning ain'tcha."
adjudicated.assessment: The dialogue's proposition, speech act, and local scene function are preserved without a material semantic error.

adjudicated.en: I give her a thumbs up.
adjudicated.assessment: The narration's principal action, state, and local relation are preserved without a material semantic error.

adjudicated.en: Touko: "..."
adjudicated.assessment: The dialogue's proposition, speech act, and local scene function are preserved without a material semantic error.

adjudicated.jp: 冬子は親指をぐっとつかんで、ごきっと横に折った。
adjudicated.en: Youko grabs my thumb tightly, and harshly twists it along with my wrist.
comments: "goki~!" is http://www.aadayo.com/aa/asciiart5115.html, harsh movement to the side. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: She grips his thumb and bends it sideways with a crack. The English turns this into twisting the thumb together with his wrist and loses the specified break-like motion.
adjudicated.remedy: Say that she bent his thumb sideways with a crack.

highlights.text: twists it along with my wrist

adjudicated.en: Taichi: "GhyEEEEEEEH!!!"
adjudicated.assessment: The dialogue's proposition, speech act, and local scene function are preserved without a material semantic error.

adjudicated.jp: 「あほーっ、折れたらどうするのだーっ！　自慰もままならないではないかーっ！」
adjudicated.en: Taichi: "Morooon, what if you'd broken iiit! I would never manage to console myself agaaain!"
comments: "Console myself" means masturbation, word and all but the euphemism works better in every instance (no really), so it's a running gag somehow. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: He explicitly complains that he would not even be able to masturbate. 'Console myself' euphemizes away the sexual joke and its reason for mentioning the hand.
adjudicated.remedy: Use an explicit equivalent of 'I wouldn't even be able to masturbate.'

adjudicated.jp: 危うく手首を返したからよかったものの。
adjudicated.en: Very fortunately, she only barely managed to twist my wrist.
comments: Should make sense, she IS getting weaker. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: He says it was fortunate that he narrowly turned his wrist, which prevented worse injury. The English makes her the actor who barely managed to twist his wrist and reverses the protective causality.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'It was a good thing I managed to turn my wrist in time.'

highlights.text: Very fortunately, she only barely managed to twist my wrist.

adjudicated.en: Touko: "Stay back and do not talk to me."
comments: Don't talk to me + don't approach me. It's thematically important so I'll keep it at least around here, see CCD2002 for the most obvious explanations. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: She only tells him not to talk to her. The English adds a command to keep physically away.

adjudicated.en: Taichi: "Did you watch TV last night?"
adjudicated.assessment: The dialogue's proposition, speech act, and local scene function are preserved without a material semantic error.

adjudicated.en: Touko: "Stay back and do not talk to me!"
comments: No denial of the existence of TV. Well, how damn convenient. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The repeated command again concerns speaking only. The English repeats an unsupported instruction to keep physically away.

adjudicated.en: Taichi: "...mngh."
adjudicated.assessment: The dialogue's proposition, speech act, and local scene function are preserved without a material semantic error.

adjudicated.jp: 話しかけないでと辛口に言われると、話しかけたくなる。
adjudicated.en: When I'm told in harsh tones not to approach or talk, I end up wanting to get close and talk.
comments: Frickin' contrarian. Remember that Touko subsists on a diet of bitterbugs. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: Being sharply told not to speak makes him want to speak. The English twice adds physical approach and closeness that are absent from the source.
adjudicated.remedy: Keep both clauses about talking without adding movement or proximity.

adjudicated.jp: 話しかけると、また、話しかけないでと辛口に言われる。
adjudicated.en: I get close and talk to her, but once more she harshly tells me to stay away and not to talk to her.
adjudicated.assessment: He talks to her and is again sharply told not to. The English adds both moving close and being ordered to stay away.
adjudicated.remedy: Keep the exchange about speaking without adding physical-distance commands.

highlights.text: get close and talk to her
stay away and not to talk to her
